main.description: Open a 覚者 DAO arbitration over a candidate or recorded karma edge. Triggered by `karma.evaluate` when recommendation = 'escalate-dao' (Tier=High Harm with zero direct witnesses), or by any caller with elevated standing (positive multi-generational karma streak). Produces an arbitration with auto-discovered 覚者 voters drawn from cohort intersection. Voting window default 7 days; 2/3 supermajority required; majority position becomes binding.

edgeId.description: Already-recorded edge to arbitrate. Mutually exclusive with `candidate`.

candidate.description: Candidate edge under deliberation (not yet recorded).

openedBy.description: DID opening the arbitration (must have 覚者 standing OR be referee for an evaluate→escalate-dao recommendation)

rationale.description: Why arbitration is needed (free-form text, also stored as encrypted CID if proofEncrypted=true at vote time)
